+    def _update_selection_poly(self, val):

+        Update the vertices of the *self.poly* slider in-place
+        to cover the data range specified by *val*.
+        """
+        # The vertices are positioned
+        #  1 ------ 2
+        #  |        |
+        #  0 ------ 3
+        vmin, vmax = val
+        if self.orientation == "vertical":
+            xy = [[.25, vmin], [.25, vmax], [.75, vmax], [.75, vmin]]
+        else:
+            xy = [[vmin, .25], [vmin, .75], [vmax, .75], [vmax, .25]]
+        # Note: assigning a new list (rather than mutating the existing one
+        # in-place) is necessary here because the number of vertices in
+        # ``self.poly.xy`` may change: if *vmin* == *vmax*, ``Polygon``
+        # elides the duplicate closing vertex (see ``Polygon.set_xy``),
+        # so the polygon may alternate between four and five vertices as
+        # its value changes.
+        self.poly.xy = xy
